title: Spire2 Pile Viewer
description:
See your teammates' draw, exhaust, and discard piles, and their hand, in co-op.

Cosmetic only: teammates don't need the mod.

[list]
[*] Each teammate gets a strip next to their name with live pile counts. [b]Click[/b] a pile to open it. [b]Drag[/b] a strip to move it.
[*] Your teammate's hand is shown behind yours, with their live costs and playable glow. Hover a card to see it in full; drag it onto an enemy to preview its numbers.
[*] Click the eye in a strip to switch teammates. [b]Hide hand[/b] (or H) hides your own hand to read theirs.
[*] Hotkeys: Shift+Z / V / C / H for teammate 1's draw / exhaust / discard / hand (Ctrl+ for teammate 2, Ctrl+Shift+ for teammate 3). Rebind to keys or extra mouse buttons.
[*] [b]F1[/b] for settings.
[/list]

Source: https://github.com/hanryhu/Spire2PileViewer
Architecture adapted from BetterSpire2 by jdr.
changeNote: v0.4.0: Strips now sit next to each teammate's name (fixed to the UI instead of following the characters) and are about as tall as a name. Hovering a strip lights up that teammate's frame. The name's own hand-count icon is hidden since the strip shows it. Strip positions you dragged before are reset.
